decision.observation: Hovered tile right of the platform read 'DIG — Dig Errand — Unreachable Dig' with Algae 202.9 kg, so the rock I marked is not adjacent to any standable cell. A dupe stands on the small ledge below-right of the platform; oxygen meter holds ~59% and rising.
decision.hypothesis: Reachability is per-tile adjacency, so designating a huge block far right is futile. Designating only the single rock tile immediately beside the dupe's ledge should be reachable and, when cleared, extends dig reach outward tile by tile.
decision.memory: Big drags into the right rock mass stay 'Unreachable Dig'. Work outward from a dupe's own standing cell, one or two tiles at a time. Diffuser blueprint right of the pod still short of Copper Ore (29.5 kg delivered of 200 kg).
